activation.boundary: First future UTC 00:15 slot after runner acceptance and sealed start receipt. No backfill of earlier slots; no deadline backdating.
activation.end: T0 + 90 days; no performance-based extension or early declaration
activation.initial_filter_state: FULL, then evaluate prior two closes at first eligible slot

FAST.candidate_weight: Positive original V13 targets x0.5 in REDUCED, otherwise original target. Nonpositive original targets unchanged.
FAST.reduced_state: No increase in positive position while REDUCED; cap desired positive quantity at currently held nonnegative quantity, after mark/equity conversion. This also prevents new long entries while REDUCED.
FAST.signal: Two consecutive daily closes below their respective trailing SMA10 => REDUCED. Two above => FULL. Equality holds state.

HALF.candidate_weight: All original V13 targets x0.5 at every slot; ordinary daily rebalance; no fast filter.

change_control: Any parameter, universe, source or executable semantic change after start needs new version and new future boundary. Preserve all prior evidence; observations already inspected are consumed for that new version.

decisions.cutoff: Daily candle of previous UTC day; raw received and source published before slot
decisions.late_policy: Record missed slot for both arms; no catch-up trade later that day
decisions.source: Same pinned original V13 weekly target vector, future daily archival proposal, shared universe and snapshot

evaluation.horizon_evaluation: Once at fixed 90-day boundary; intermediate weekly checks only completeness and safety, performance descriptive not parameter selection
evaluation.missing_policy: Preserve every economic outcome; missing marks or funding remain unknown until causally reconstructed with provenance. Terminal net accounting must reconcile in both arms; no favorable-subset scoring.
evaluation.positive_candidate_rule: Primary delta > 0 AND FAST observed drawdown <= HALF on common valid grid AND data/coverage gates pass. Otherwise mixed/negative; if gates fail INCONCLUSIVE. Meeting rule is not statistical proof or operational approval.
evaluation.primary: log(E_FAST_T/E_FAST_0)-log(E_HALF_T/E_HALF_0), net of simulated costs and estimated reconciled funding
secondary: forecast risk gap and paired valid slot count
turnover, fees, funding and estimator quality
entry blocks, reductions, regime transitions and reentry costs
per-symbol attribution and foregone rebound intervals
evaluation.valuation_grid: Shared 5-minute causal observation grid using existing capture if complete, plus daily UTC 00:15 observation; no new collector in this task

execution.accounts: Two independent research-only ledgers; no approval store, intent to operational executor, grant or live account writes
execution.costs: Include initial entry, reentries, fees, funding and unrealized P/L; no free initial positions or free end liquidation
execution.limits_on_pair: If either arm blocks an increase, block increases in both; reductions remain allowed. Record resulting risk mismatch. Do not bypass guards to force parity.
execution.minimums: Separate simulation contract only; real KuCoin min_quantity/min_notional remain UNKNOWN
execution.paired_snapshot: Same first complete causal book bundle for all 18 symbols after slot and within 120 seconds
execution.pricing: Existing archived/public depth VWAP, adverse 2bps, adverse tick rounding, fee at least 6bps; full-size feasible fill or recorded capacity limitation
execution.risk_limits: 2% daily loss, 10% high-water drawdown, one risk-increasing rebalance/day UTC, 22h cooldown, 31.5% per symbol and 90% gross, independently enforced and persisted for each arm
execution.storage_failure: No new fills if durable journal/slot reservation is unavailable; recover idempotently, never reset equity, filter, funding debt or limits.

funding: Observed public settlements with causal previous observed reference mark; estimated, never official exchange ledger. Missing coverage is explicit debt, not zero.

readiness.next: Implement isolated prospective writer and parity tests, qualify causal feeds and coverage, then seal T0 before first future observation. Existing historical diagnostic is not that runner.

risk_matching.covariance: Sample covariance ddof=1; C=0.8*S+0.2*diag(S); no parameter fit
risk_matching.interpretation: HALF has a constant preliminary multiplier, but final risk-matched allocation may be scaled further down. This tests allocation/selection under common forecast risk, not the full value of varying total market exposure. Ex-ante parity is not realized risk equality.
risk_matching.mismatch_policy: Record mismatch and retain both full economic outcomes; do not drop bad days or iteratively optimize quantities after outcome. Do not label mismatched intervals risk-equal.
ordering: form candidate weights including FAST quantity cap
apply shared gross/per-symbol caps by downscaling
compute both predicted volatilities from the same C
scale each candidate by v_common/v_arm, never above one
if either risk is zero, target both flat
convert to executable quantities with own equity and same book/precision/cost model
recompute predicted risk after actual simulated fills and mark to common book
risk_matching.returns: 60 contiguous daily simple returns, from 61 closed prices, common across all 18 symbols, available before slot
